search_text: published ZDI-11-232 ZDI-CAN-1082 HP iNode Management Center iNodeMngChecker.exe Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2011-07-01 CVE-2011-1867 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2011-1867 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['iNode Management Center'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of HP H3C/3Com iNode Management Center. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The flaw exists within the iNOdeMngChecker.exe component which listens by default on TCP port 9090. When handling the 0x0A0BF007 packet type the process blindly copies user supplied data into a fixed-length buffer on the stack. A remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of the SYSTEM user. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
